title: (3.0beta5) Frozen screen/app crashes/update basal profile error
body:
Aaps 3.0 beta 5
Combo/Ruffy
Dexcom G6 (Build your own app)
Phone: Google Pixel 4XL Android 12

Problems:
- Screen freezes sometimes when I switch profile. Sometimes the app crashes with the message wait or close. I get that message a lot more now. 
- The connection with combo looks slower. 
- Update of basal profile failed error (at night, sometimes during the day
Thanks a lot.

Battery optimization is off, Play Protect is off.
The app has all rights, ...

Hmm unfortunately I do not see anything that hints at the underlying cause. I do see the error, but not any more details. The RT_DISPLAY, RT_AUDIO etc. packets just eventually stop coming in because for unknown reasons the BT connection fails. I also checked the application layer packets that have the reliability bit set, and their error codes are set to 0. A nonzero code would give us more details. That is not a problem on your end - it is just that we don't get any more data from Ruffy or the Combo.

Still, my main suspicion is also that the ringbuffer inside the Combo overruns. I see the following two options for how to proceed:

1. Use git bisect to see if you can pinpoint a particular commit that introduced this problem.
2. Lengthen the waiting periods between the basal rate factor updates (and maybe also during the factor updates), then see if this still happens. This amounts to tweaking some of the sleep() calls inside the Combo AAPS plugin. @jotomo , any suggestions which ones to tweak?

There's an additional sleep here (in addition the to 150ms after each press): https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/32873e073087e8dc05c483d29bb836885b77e66c/combo/src/main/java/info/nightscout/androidaps/plugins/pump/combo/ruffyscripter/commands/SetBasalProfileCommand.java#L100
Though that code hasn't changed in four years.
I went through the changes between beta3 and beta5 (https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/compare/3.0-beta3...3.0-beta5), but there's nothing suspicious there (no change in Combo code, nothing that could cause hangs/ANRs).
I doubt the issue is in ComboPlugin or ruffyscripter-land, the code is mature and functionally untouched for quiet a while.
... somewhat at a loss as to what might cause the observed behavior.
@jotomo  Perhaps this is a dormant bug that is only triggered in Android 12 for some reason. It would perhaps be useful to try to see if this happens in Android 10 and 11 as well.
@Els3401 Can you try to raise the sleep period in the location @jotomo mentioned from 50 to 200 for example? Perhaps it works then for you?

I have done also a reset of wifi, bluetooth and mobile. I deleted Aaps and Ruffy before (and deleted also the bluetooth connections). And installed everything following the docs. Sadly, it doesn't help.
